cohort: 150 iron-deficiency anemic pregnant women between 16 and 32 weeks of gestation with hemoglobin between 5 and 9 gm/dL
finding: A single dose of FCM significantly increased hemoglobin levels at 2 weeks (1.35 gm/dL), 6 weeks (3.08 gm/dL), and at delivery (4.80 gm/dL).
country: India (implied by mention of DCGI approval and clinical use in the Indian population)
